summary: Comprehensive testing of IdeaRadar new features: Stripe payment integration, Password reset flow, and Scan Any Topic AI feature. All backend tests pass (18/18). Frontend UI verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Password reset code is returned in API response (demo mode) - this is intentional for testing but should be removed in production
Stripe uses test key (sk_test_emergent) - correct for testing environment
Scan Topic feature correctly returns 402 for free users with clear upgrade message
seed_data_creation: Created test users during password reset flow testing (TEST_reset_* prefix)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Stripe checkout creates sessions with correct amounts ($40 Pro, $60 Business), 2) Password reset flow works end-to-end (forgot-password returns 6-digit code, reset-password validates code and updates password), 3) Scan Topic returns 402 for free users, 4) Theme toggle works across all pages including auth page. User stripetest@test.com is on free tier.

stripe_checkout.details: POST /api/subscription/checkout creates Stripe checkout sessions for both Pro ($40) and Business ($60) tiers. Returns checkout URL and session_id. Invalid tier returns 400. Requires auth.

subscription_status.details: GET /api/subscription/status/{session_id} returns payment status. Returns 404 for invalid session. Requires auth.

stripe_webhook.details: POST /api/webhook/stripe endpoint exists and responds. Returns status ok/error.

password_reset_forgot.details: POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns 6-digit code for valid email (demo mode). Returns generic message for invalid email (security).

password_reset_confirm.details: POST /api/auth/reset-password validates code and updates password. Wrong code returns 400. Full flow tested: forgot -> reset -> login with new password.

scan_topic.details: POST /api/ideas/scan-topic returns 402 for free users with 'Upgrade to Pro or Business' message. Requires auth.

pricing_page_ui.details: 3-tier pricing displayed correctly: Free ($0), Pro ($40/month with POPULAR badge), Business ($60/month with BEST VALUE badge). CTA buttons show 'Get Pro' and 'Get Business' for non-logged-in users.

auth_page_forgot_password.details: Auth page has 'Forgot password?' link. Clicking it shows forgot password mode. After submitting email, shows reset code (demo mode) and reset password form with code input and new password input.

dashboard_scan_topic.details: Dashboard has Scan Topic input with Sparkles icon. Input and button are disabled for free users. Shows 'Upgrade to Pro to scan any topic...' placeholder. PRO badge displayed.

payment_success_route.details: /payment/success route exists. Correctly redirects to auth when not logged in (protected route). Shows payment processing UI with polling.

theme_toggle.details: Theme toggle works on auth page (has data-testid='auth-theme-toggle'). Theme persists across navigation (stored in localStorage as 'idearadar_theme'). Both dark and light themes render correctly.

mocked_apis_list: Stripe uses test key (sk_test_emergent) - creates real test checkout sessions
Password reset code returned in API response (demo mode - no email service)
